description: This is a shell script used for managing PPPoE link states on a network device, involving bringing the WAN IPv4 link up or down, provisioning the interface, and managing related system states and routing.

methods.name: do_start_pppoe
methods.description: Starts the PPPoE link by setting the current_ipv4_link_state to up and logging the action.

methods.name: do_stop_pppoe
methods.description: Stops the PPPoE link by setting the current_ipv4_link_state to down and logging the action.
